models_evaluated: Real-time decision support system for fetal ultrasound rare disease diagnosis (phenotype-based)

links.outcome: Retrospective performance of decision support system on clinical cases against confirmed postnatal diagnoses
links.effect: Ascertained diagnosis in top-10 list in 93% (full phenotype) and 83% (stepwise) of syndromic cases after adjudication; specificity 94%/96%, sensitivity 99%/84%.
links.quote: For syndromic cases, the ascertained diagnosis was within the top-10 list in 93% and 83% of cases using the full-phenotype and stepwise input, respectively, after adjudication.

screen.reason: Evaluates the diagnostic accuracy of a clinical decision support system for fetal ultrasound phenotypes on retrospective data comparing full-phenotype vs stepwise inputs, but does not test a specific organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
